title: Why Chinese AI Models Aren't the Bargain Bloggers Claim
description:
Stop trusting bloggers who hype chinese AI models 🔥 With cars, going chinese saves you 30-50%, thats real money. But AI is diffrent: Kimi sub is $150, Anthropic is $200. Just $50 gap 😅 No sane founder trades 30% of quality to save fifty bucks, when $200 gets you near-unlimited Opus 4.8 plus Fable 5 ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
